name: ECS Pattern
description: Entity-Component-System 架構規則：確保 Component 為純資料結構、System 為純邏輯且不持有狀態。

unity64Notes.corePackages: On the Unity 6.4 baseline, Entities, Collections, Mathematics and Entities Graphics are Core packages that ship with the Editor. Do NOT call manage_packages(action: "add_package") for com.unity.entities, com.unity.collections, com.unity.mathematics or com.unity.entities.graphics on 6.4 -- confirm what is already installed with manage_packages(action: "list_packages") instead, which is asynchronous (poll manage_packages(action: "status", job_id: ...) with the returned job_id).
